Challenges

Sound familiar?

“AI answers name our competitors, never us.”

Assistants cite brands they understand and trust. The visibility audit shows exactly how each platform describes you today — and what to fix first.

“Our traffic is dipping as AI Overviews spread.”

Clicks are moving into answers. Being the cited source inside the answer is the new page one — and it is winnable with citable content.

“ChatGPT describes our company wrong.”

Models repeat what the web consistently says. Entity optimisation aligns your facts everywhere they are read from.

“We don’t know if AI search even matters for us.”

The baseline audit measures your category’s AI-answer presence — how often assistants answer your buyers’ questions and who they name.

“Our content is good but never gets quoted.”

Citable content is structured differently: clear claims, sourced figures, direct answers. Priority pages get restructured for exactly that.

“Agencies sell us “AI SEO” that’s just normal SEO.”

The foundations overlap — the deliverables differ: entity reports, citation tracking and answer-ready content, measured in SERPLoft™.

“Every platform answers differently.”

True — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot draw on different signals. Tracking and fixes are per-platform, not one-size.

“Leadership wants an AI search strategy yesterday.”

Start with the audit: a measured baseline and a prioritised fix list beats a panic rebuild.

How It Works

Search changed; the fundamentals evolved with it

AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot answer questions by synthesising sources they trust. Brands that are clearly understood — strong entities, consistent facts, cited expertise — get named. Others get summarised away.

Our AI SEO program strengthens exactly those signals: entity clarity, quotable expert content, authoritative mentions and the technical structure that helps AI systems read and attribute your pages correctly.

  • AI visibility audit
  • Entity consistency report
  • Answer-ready content upgrades
  • Citation-building campaign

FAQs

FAQs on AI SEO services

Is AI SEO different from normal SEO?

It builds on the same foundations — crawlability, content, authority — but optimises additionally for being cited inside generated answers.

Can you track AI visibility?

Yes — SERPLoft™ monitors brand presence across AI answer surfaces for your key topics.

Does AI SEO replace our SEO program?

No — it extends it. Sites with weak classic SEO rarely get cited by AI either.

How fast are results?

Entity and content fixes can change AI answers within weeks; authority-driven gains build over quarters.

Which AI platforms do you track?

ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Copilot as standard, with Grok and DeepSeek where your market uses them.

Can you guarantee citations?

No one honestly can — models change constantly. What we guarantee is the measured work: entity fixes, citable content and citation building, with visibility tracked so progress is visible.
